title: COLCA CANYON & HOT SPRINGS
description: Explore one of the deepest canyons in the world and relax in natural hot springs. The Colca Canyon will surprise you with its landscapes and the majesty of the Andean condor.
shortItinerary: Day 1: Arequipa - Colca Canyon - Hot Springs
Day 2: Cruz del Cóndor - Chivay - Arequipa

itinerary.title: Arequipa - Colca Canyon - Hot Springs
itinerary.description: Early departure from Arequipa, we'll cross the highlands with views of Misti and Chachani volcanoes. We arrive at Colca Canyon to observe condors and end the day relaxing in the La Calera hot springs.

itinerary.title: Cruz del Cóndor - Chivay - Arequipa
itinerary.description: Early morning to reach the Cruz del Cóndor and watch the spectacle of condors soaring over the canyon. Visit to the town of Chivay and return to Arequipa in the afternoon.

recommendations: Bring warm clothing for high altitudes
